title: Evidence Card v1.0 (user-validation-designer variant)
description: Same 12 required fields as the product-technical-audit Evidence Card, so evidence_calibration_agent audits one shape. Two deliberate narrowings: reliability_level is capped at E2 because every product of this skill is simulated (KB global convention), and evidence_type / valid_for_dimensions use the user-side vocabulary. expiry stays required but is never defaulted by this skill (DECISIONS D-04).

source.description: URL, upstream evidence id, experience report ref, or object-store key of the simulation transcript.

source_tier.description: SOURCE CLASS (canonical contract launchscope://shared/evidence-card/1.0). Not an evidence level. Simulated output is typically tier_3 (model restatement); an upstream experience report is tier_2; the product surface itself is tier_1. Judged independently of reliability_level.

timestamp.description: Collection time, ISO8601. Never the publication time.

reliability_level.description: LaunchScope EVIDENCE LEVEL. HARD CEILING E2: this skill never issues E3-E5, because real user evidence is only ever ingested (existing_user_evidence, kept as a separate ingested record) or planned (validation_plans) - never produced. A model-supplied E3+ is clamped to E2 and logged in evidence_level_summary.downgraded_entries.

supporting_claims.description: Claim / hypothesis / persona ids this card supports. Orphan cards are rejected.

expiry.description: Supplied by caller or runtime. This skill applies no default lifetime and makes no staleness judgement; evidence_calibration_agent decides (DECISIONS D-04). Use the literal "unknown" when genuinely unavailable, which also raises a missing_information entry.

content_hash.description: sha256 over the captured artefact, for replayability.

observation.description: Observed facts only. Inference belongs in dimensions[].basis, never here.

conflict_with.description: Conflicting evidence ids. Both sides are retained; arbitration belongs to evidence_calibration_agent (KB-USR-B04: never average).

simulation_note.description: Present on simulated cards: which persona and which simulation unit produced it.
